contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' contributions (21,753.55) on the p2 SUMMARY PAGE, which is ALSO Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' (21,753.55 - identical because this is the cycle's first and only report on this cover, line 3 Balance at Beginning = 0) and is ALSO the attached typed ledger's own printed 'Total  $ 21,753.55' at the foot of p4
contributions.detail: The 44 rows of the filer's own typed contributions ledger (p4) sum to 21,953.52, which is 199.97 MORE than the anchor 21,753.55. THE DELTA IS TRACED, AND TO A UNIQUE PAIR OF ROWS: 21,953.52 - 100.00 (row 1, Chris Nichols) - 99.97 (row 44, Bill Freeze In kind) = 21,753.55 EXACTLY. The attribution is forced twice over. (a) CENTS: only two rows carry non-zero cents (190.55 and 99.97); a difference ending in .97 can only be produced by omitting 99.97, so row 44 is in the omitted set by arithmetic, not by choice. (b) CONTIGUITY: the residual 100.00 of round dollars must come from somewhere, and the ONLY prefix+suffix (i.e. spreadsheet-SUM-range) explanation is {row 1} + {row 44} - row 1 is the single 100.00 at the head of the list; any other contiguous prefix overshoots (row 2 is 5,000.00) and any other contiguous suffix undershoots or overshoots (rows 43+44 = 290.52). (c) CORRELATED-ERROR SCREEN, run per the brief and POSITIVE in the diagnostic direction: the SAME FILING's expenditure ledger (p6) makes the same class of error and omits ITS first data row - so the pattern is one spreadsheet SUM range started one row low on both sheets, i.e. FILER ARITHMETIC, not a transcription failure. NOTHING WAS NUDGED: every one of the 44 rows is transcribed at its printed value, the delta is retained verbatim, and the cover's own ladder (0 + 21,753.55 - 11,604.56 = 10,148.99 at line 7) closes on the filer's stated figures to the cent. IN-KIND: see in_kind_convention - the closing convention is monetary PLUS in-kind, inline.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' expenditures (11,604.56) on the p2 SUMMARY PAGE, which is ALSO Column B (11,604.56) and ALSO the attached typed ledger's own printed 'TOTAL  $ 11,604.56' at the foot of p6
expenditures.detail: The 22 rows of the filer's own typed expenditure ledger (p6) sum to 12,604.54, which is 999.98 MORE than the anchor 11,604.56. THE DELTA IS TRACED TO ONE ROW AND IS UNIQUELY ATTRIBUTABLE: 12,604.54 - 999.98 = 11,604.56 EXACTLY, and 999.98 is precisely the printed amount of ROW 1 (Collegiate Desings, 28-Aug, T-shirts) - the FIRST data row, the one a SUM range that starts a line too low would drop. No other single row equals 999.98 and no other subset was needed. This is corroborated inside the same document by the contribution ledger, whose own printed Total likewise omits its first data row (plus its last). FILER ARITHMETIC, retained verbatim: no amount was changed and the cover's balance ladder closes on the filer's stated 11,604.56.

in_kind_convention: MONETARY PLUS IN-KIND, INLINE - tested both ways as the brief requires. The ledger carries two rows the filer himself labels 'In kind' (190.55 and 99.97) in the same amount column as the cash rows, with no separate in-kind total anywhere on the filing. Monetary-only (dropping both) gives 21,663.00, which is 90.55 BELOW the anchor and explains nothing; monetary-plus-in-kind gives 21,953.52, whose 199.97 excess resolves EXACTLY and uniquely into the filer's own SUM-range omission (rows 1 and 44). The 190.55 in-kind row sits INSIDE the filer's summed range, which is the positive proof that his stated 21,753.55 is an in-kind-inclusive figure.

4.measure_note: p4 is NOT a county form: it is the candidate's OWN TYPED LEDGER attached behind the (blank) county Schedule A, so rowbands.py finds ZERO printed rules on it and the A2 recovery applies. Measured with `rowbands.py <pdf> 4 --text-lines --col 41,51` restricted to the amount column, which returns 45 clean text bands at a regular pitch of 1.865 - 44 data rows from 9.47 to 89.51 plus ONE MORE at 92.24 which is the ledger's own printed 'Total' line. Column bands measured by ink projection over the data region: NAME 8.29-36.41, AMOUNT 41.29-50.18, DATE 52.12-58.88, ADDRESS 58.94-87.35 - note the filer's OWN column ORDER (Name, Amount, Date, Address) differs from the county form's (Date, Name, Address, Amount), which is exactly the field-shift risk the brief warns about; the columns were assigned from the ledger's own layout, not from the county form's headings. THREE CONTROL CROPS AT 900 dpi AND WHAT THEY ACTUALLY RENDERED: row 1 box pct:41.0,9.47,10.0,0.95@p4 rendered '$   100.00' (recorded 100.00 for Chris Nichols); row 44 box pct:41.0,88.56,10.0,0.95@p4 rendered '$    99.97' (recorded 99.97 for the second Bill Freeze In kind row); and THE ONE-PAST-THE-END CONTROL, the band immediately after the last data row, pct:41.0,92.24,10.0,0.95@p4, rendered '$ 21,753.55' - i.e. the ledger's printed TOTAL and not a 45th donor, which is the proof the 44 bands stop where the data stops.

6.measure_note: p6 is the candidate's OWN TYPED EXPENDITURE LEDGER and it is a ROTATED LANDSCAPE SHEET: poppler renders it portrait 1700x2200 with the text turned 90 degrees, so axis='x' - the printed rows advance along the RENDERED x axis (and in DESCENDING x: row 1 is the right-most band at 86.12-87.71, row 22 the left-most at 36.12-37.76), while the AMOUNT column is a band on the rendered y axis at 19.50-27.00. rowbands.py returns 0 rules here as it does on any such sheet, so the bands were measured by projecting ink inside the amount strip onto the x axis, which yields 23 clean clusters at a regular pitch of ~2.36: 22 data rows plus ONE MORE at 28.94-30.59 which is the ledger's own printed 'TOTAL' line. Column bands on the y axis (measured over the data rows): VENDOR 6.86-17.91, AMOUNT 19.82-26.82, DATE 29.73-33.82, ADDRESS 34.23-52.00, PURPOSE 54.09-69.32 - this ledger DOES carry a purpose column of the filer's own, so purpose is transcribed rather than left blank. THREE CONTROL CROPS AT 900 dpi (rotated for reading) AND WHAT THEY ACTUALLY RENDERED: row 1 box pct:86.12,19.50,1.59,7.50@p6 rendered '$   999.98' (recorded 999.98 for Collegiate Desings); row 22 box pct:36.12,19.50,1.64,7.50@p6 rendered '$ 1,089.00' (recorded 1089.00 for the 26-Oct Herald ad); and THE ONE-PAST-THE-END CONTROL at pct:28.94,19.50,1.65,7.50@p6 rendered '$ 11,604.56' - the ledger's printed TOTAL, not a 23rd vendor.

THE A2 CASE, AND IT IS THE CLEAN VERSION OF IT: p3 and p5 are the county's printed Schedule A and Schedule B blanks and they are ENTIRELY UNFILLED - every one of the 17 underlines empty on each, the Page/of, Last Name and Date of Report header boxes empty, and both the 'Subtotal for this page' and 'Total Contributions Received' / 'Total Expenditures Received' lines empty. The blank p3/p5 forms are recorded here so a reader is not surprised by them.

FORM-VARIANT NOTE WORTH THE WAVE'S ATTENTION: this filing's p5 Schedule B prints 'Purchased From/Source' and its p3 Schedule A prints 'Address, City & Zip' - matching the reference record 40bd7997 - whereas the OTHER 2014 blank in this same chunk (c969ce67, Tracy) is titled 'FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES' with no '& LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD' and reuses Schedule A's headings on Schedule B. Two distinct 2014 blanks circulated.

FOLIATION: every Page/of box on p2, p3 and p5 is BLANK - a fifth foliation practice alongside the four Addendum C6 records. Page ordinals locate nothing here.

THE TWO DELTAS ARE ONE FILER HABIT, NOT TWO DEFECTS - see recon on both sides. Both of the filer's own printed totals were computed over a SUM range that started one row low; on the contribution sheet it also stopped one row short. All 66 rows are transcribed at their printed values and both deltas are retained verbatim.

DATES: EVERY row on both ledgers prints a day-and-month with NO YEAR ('15-Aug', '26-Oct'). Kept VERBATIM per the frozen contract; a year is never filled in from the report date, and the build blanks such a date and flags it. The cycle is not in doubt (the cover is signed 10/28/14) but the CELL does not say so.

PRIVACY: the contribution ledger prints full street lines for nearly every donor and this file is NOT a *_Redacted.pdf - the county published it in the clear. Reduced to city/state at READ TIME; no street line, box number or phone number is carried into any field or note. Where a city is blank the row's note says WHICH cause: row 9 (Steve Strong) is the one row where the ledger itself prints no city. Donor STATE is blank on the Utah rows because the ledger simply does not print one - not inferred from the city. Expenditure rows carry no address field at all.

AN OBSERVED COINCIDENCE, RECORDED BUT NOT USED (the C3 discipline): the two in-kind contribution amounts 190.55 and 99.97 equal, to the cent, two expenditure rows on p6 (Facebook 190.55 'Facebook ads' and Walmart 99.97 'bike for Scera giveaway').
